name: KAIST classic PTY to static PWA browser replay
target: Replays one real fake-member classic PTY absorb-build receipt through fixed loopback Nexus API responses and a built static PWA, then captures browser receipts for scenes 2, 3, 5, and 6 with the source build runId preserved.
inputs: captured KAIST_KCB_RECEIPTS or KCB_TICKET_RECEIPTS output from the classic PTY graph route test
static PWA export built from the current checkout
fake member owner, briefing, suggestion, board, graph-run, and app-artifact fields from the PTY receipt
observations: scenes 2 and 3 retain the shared briefing runId from the classic PTY output
scenes 5 and 6 retain the shared absorb-build runId and matching graph, board card, result URL, and attachment SHA-256
real headless Chromium renders each expected screen and saves a PNG plus JSON receipt
API fixtures bind only to the captured fake member; unknown API paths fail closed and external requests fail the replay
KCB ticketing receipt records briefing/acceptance/capacity contract mapping; fields absent from actual PTY output stay marked missing
entryCommands: bun test src/dashboard/plugin-route-adapter.test.ts -t "classic dashboard PTY carries KAIST scenes 1–6"
CLASSIC_TICKET_SCENARIO=1 ELANOUS_TRACK=OP bun test src/dashboard/plugin-route-adapter.test.ts -t "classic dashboard PTY carries KAIST scenes 1–6"
ELANOUS_TRACK=OP bun bin/elanous.mjs nexus build --cwd apps/pwa

ELANOUS_REMOTE_HOST=node-b CHROME_BIN="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" bun test src/ux-sim/kaist-classic-pwa-replay-world.test.ts src/ux-sim/kaist-classic-pwa-browser-replay.test.ts

KAIST_CLASSIC_PTY_RECEIPT_PATH=src/ux-sim/fixtures/kcb-ticket-classic-pty-receipt.json ELANOUS_REMOTE_HOST=node-b CHROME_BIN="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" bun test src/ux-sim/kaist-classic-pwa-replay-world.test.ts src/ux-sim/kaist-classic-pwa-browser-replay.test.ts
